source_execution: Each producer is a single ASCII Python source file invoked as python -I -B from a captured copy. Repo-local imports are rejected, so no captured pyc can substitute for source. Native runtime commands and every deployed runtime-bundle file must be exact-bound by the future command plan and successor readiness evidence.
